drhp.business: The Company continues to operate in the manufacturing of pharmaceuticals segment and a renewable energy segment. During FY 2025-26 net sales grew across both exports and domestic markets, which management attributed to sustained demand, operational efficiency and cost management.
drhp.expansion: The Company owns two wind turbines at Jaisalmer, Rajasthan with a combined capacity of 1.6 MW; the electricity generated is sold on the Indian Energy Exchange. No new capex or expansion project with a commissioning/completion timeline was disclosed in this section.
